error.message: updateidentity: Cannot revoke an identity with self as the recovery authority, unless the ID has tokenized ID control

limitations: No owned identity had its lock bit set or version below 3; unlock arithmetic and actual legacy-source upgrades use source-derived unit fixtures.
Only unsigned/unbroadcast updateidentity returntx=true templates are captured. Consensus acceptance and broadcast are not asserted.
The daemon JSON RPC exposes one private address; complete vectors use raw-byte unit fixtures.
